$comment: THE physical column-name rule, shared by the data-runner (app.py loads this file) and os-ui (tabs/data/lib/dbt/literal.ts COLUMN_NAME_RULE, held equal to this file by literal-column-rule.test.ts). Counted in Unicode CODE POINTS (an emoji is one). A name is 1..maxCodePoints code points, holds no code point inside a 'forbidden' range, and neither starts nor ends with one inside an 'edgeForbidden' range. Ranges are inclusive [first, last].
